family.name: statewide truck parking study
family.authoritative_delivery_context: NMDOT's public realfile.rtsclients.com host, linked from dot.nm.gov; the saved research records 42 already-validated archive records from this endpoint.
family.series_finding: The records are the complete ordered set of seven numbered deliverables: project management, stakeholder engagement, literature review and best practices, freight activity evaluation, supply and demand, interstate assessment, and recommendation and implementation.
family.standalone_archival_value: Each deliverable preserves a distinct substantive study stage and is necessary to retain the complete statewide freight and highway reference record; the planning, evidence, assessment, and implementation materials are not interchangeable.
family.abqinfo_scope_finding: Statewide freight, interstate, and truck-parking analysis is transportation-reference material relevant to Albuquerque's state-highway context.

container_summary.preservation_requirement: Preserve every original container exactly; do not convert the five OOXML/DOCX study components to PDF.

placement_review.reason: The page already curates NMDOT highway studies affecting Albuquerque and its transportation context. This complete statewide truck-parking study fits there better than a generic transportation landing page; no public edit is authorized until every record clears archival and public-byte-verification gates.

cross_listing.reason: The saved research notes statewide freight relevance, but a public cross-listing should be assessed only with the archive-ready family and final presentation.

required_before_public_content: Archive each original to R2 in its exact saved container.
Verify each public archive download against its saved exact size and SHA-256 and retain authoritative NMDOT-source provenance.
Perform final family-level publication and quality review before any page edit.
prohibited_now: No R2 upload or other storage mutation.
No public-content edit, implementation, validation, merge, or deployment.
No conversion of OOXML originals to PDF.
